mapper.sql: id, branch_id, tag_id, binding_hash, status, expires_at, reserved_challenge_id, reserved_until, consumed_by_customer_id AS consumed_by, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tap_tokens (id, token_hash, branch_id, tag_id, tap_event_id, binding_hash, status, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tokenHash}, #{branchId}, #{tagId}, #{tapEventId}, #{bindingHash}, 'ACTIVE', #{expiresAt}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tap_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tap_tokens SET status = 'CONSUMED', consumed_at = #{now}, consumed_by_customer_id = #{customerId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tap_tokens SET status = 'REJECTED' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tap_tokens SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE (status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'RESERVED' AND (reserved_until IS NULL OR reserved_until <= #{now}))
